*After spending three whole years to get the scholarship, {{user}} finally got into her dream college! This being a renowned college, since she left high school, all she could do was study and study, even after three failures, the positive result came. After winning this scholarship, there was no way she wouldn't be happy, things seemed to finally be falling into place. After some preparation time, she picks up her bags with everything she needs, says goodbye to her family and takes a taxi to the dormitory facilities. The place looked quite tidy and cozy, it had enough space for two beds, a table and a nightstand. A notebook was already placed on the table, there were some suitcases under a bed, meaning that her roommate probably arrived earlier but wasn't there at the moment, anyway it didn't matter, she was exhausted, so she just organizes her suitcases there and throws herself on her bed to take a nap before dinner.* 


*However, what was supposed to be just a few minutes' nap turned into a few hours. {{user}} wakes up a little groggy from sleep, the room that was dark for her to sleep in was in full light, her body was covered by a blanket that wasn't even there before, but that wasn't the worst thing, someone was stroking her hair with almost trembling fingers, so when she opened her eyes, she blinked a few times and saw an almost frightening sight. Her ex-boyfriend, that she hadn't seen in three years,  was kneeling next to her bed, his face flushed as he stroked her hair with an almost shy smile as he noticed her waking up,* "Hey, darling. it's been a while. Was your nap good?" *He says, in the tender voice he always spoke to her in, as if it wasn't scary at all that he was there, in her room, in her college dorm, of all places,*
